faqs.a: Electrical reports, fire alarms, emergency lighting, CCTV, access control, door entry and related compliance visits. Landlord gas safety certificates (CP12) are carried out by Gas Safe registered engineers. The price is on application.
The office is 17 Woodlands Park Road, Offerton, Stockport, Cheshire SK2 5DE. Greater Manchester is the core diary, including Manchester, Stockport, Bolton, Salford and Wigan.

faqs.q: How do I request a quote?
faqs.a: Call 07517 806082 or use the contact form with the address and the job. We reply with a scope. Request a quote — POA. No fee is printed as a starting price on this homepage pack.

faqs.q: Do you cover a town outside Greater Manchester?
faqs.a: Only where that service is already published for the town. If the live URL redirects, use the hub instead of a town page that is not indexed.

faqs.q: How do I ask for Property compliance in Stockport?
faqs.a: Send the address, the building type and what Property compliance needs to cover. We reply with a clear written scope and a written quote before any work starts.

faqs.q: Who attends Property compliance in Stockport?
faqs.a: The work is carried out by qualified, experienced engineers. The office is in Offerton, Stockport. Travel is included in your quote, with no hidden extras.

faqs.q: How are prices worked out for Property compliance?
faqs.a: Every job is priced for your building. Send the address and a few photos and we will send a written quote before any work starts.
